name: RundfunkArr
short_desc: German public broadcasting indexer and downloader for Sonarr and Radarr
author: rundfunkarr
description: RundfunkArr searches public broadcaster media libraries and integrates with Sonarr, Radarr and Prowlarr through Newznab and SABnzbd-compatible APIs. Includes direct downloads, optional MKV conversion and scheduled searches.

form_fields.label: Diagnostics admin key
form_fields.hint: Enter this generated key on Diagnostics & Logs to unlock diagnostics. This is separate from the login password and integration API key.
